items.title: OSRS GE Prices
items.summary: Use live OSRS market prices through the existing MarketPrices abstraction.
details: Add an OSRS market-price provider behind the existing MarketPrices interface.
Cache prices server-side and refresh periodically; never request prices per player action.
Keep DefaultMarketPrices / uncert(type).cost as fallback when no live price is available.
Keep High Alch and Low Alch values independent from GE prices.
Preserve the abstraction so this can later be replaced by this server's own Grand Exchange pricing.

items.title: Improved Item Examine
items.summary: Show the normal description plus GE, High Alch and Low Alch values.
details: Centralize item Examine output so inventory, bank, shops, price checker and ground items stay consistent.
Preserve the normal item description.
Add a value line with GE value, High Alch value and Low Alch value.
Use the central MarketPrices provider for GE and existing item definitions for HA/LA.
Resolve noted items to the appropriate underlying item values where required.

items.title: Collection Log Reward Broadcasts
items.summary: Broadcast Collection Log uniques and pets server-wide when obtained.
details: Treat Collection Log membership as the source of truth; do not maintain a separate unique or pet whitelist.
Broadcast every qualifying obtain, including repeat obtains.
Keep the personal 'New item added to your collection log' message only for first-time unlocks.
Pass reward-source context where available so messages can name the boss, minigame, raid, chest or activity.
Example: [Collection Log] Bram received an Araxyte fang from Araxxor!

items.title: Notification Queue
items.summary: Queue client notifications so multiple unlock popups display one after another.
details: Add a reusable per-player FIFO notification queue.
Route Collection Log clientscript 3343 popups through the queue.
Multiple new items from one kill or reward must display sequentially instead of overwriting one another.
Multiple copies of the same newly unlocked item should still produce only one first-unlock popup.
Reuse the queue later for Combat Achievements, Achievement Diaries, quests and other notifications.
Clear or discard pending notifications safely on logout or invalid player state.

items.title: Own Grand Exchange
items.summary: Eventually replace external OSRS guide prices with the server's own economy.
details: Build the server's own Grand Exchange after the temporary OSRS price feed is in place.
Make completed trades the authoritative source for this server's market prices.
Swap the MarketPrices implementation without changing Examine or other price consumers.
